# Security policy

Julz is a personal project that runs on one laptop. There are no releases for others and no
supported versions, so a fix lands on main and nowhere else.

If you find a security problem in this code, please report it privately through the Security
tab of this repository ("Report a vulnerability") rather than in a public issue. I read every
report and will answer when I can. This is a hobby project, so there is no bounty.

Comments in the code name threats by number, such as "SECURITY.md 136". They refer to my
private threat model, which is not part of this repository.
